Package com.example.volt.map

Class MapManager

java.lang.Object
com.example.volt.map.MapManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
OnPopupDestinationChangedListener, OnPopupViewClosedListener
public class MapManager extends Object implements OnPopupDestinationChangedListener, OnPopupViewClosedListener
PopupManager is a link layer between MapView, PinButtonView, and the other managers. Controls zooming and highlighting.

Representation Invariant:

  • mapView != null
  • destinationToViewMap != null
  • foreach key in destinationToViewMap: key != null
  • foreach value in destinationToViewMap: value != null
  • destinationSelectedCommand != null

Abstraction Function:

MapManager mm represents a link between MapView, PinButtonView, and the other managers allowing zooming and highlighting such that:
  • mm.mapView represents the map.
  • pm.currentlyHighlighted represents the currently highlighted Destination.
  • mm.destinationToViewMap represents a mapping from Destination to its visual representation.
  • mm.destinationSelectedCommand represents the operations to execute when a Destination is selected.
